transcript.t: Mr Li, why is the ocean so important?
It gives us oxygen and food, and it is home to many animals.
I saw a video about plastic in the sea. It was sad.
Yes, plastic hurts turtles and fish. They often eat it by mistake.
What can we do to protect them?
Use fewer plastic bags and take your rubbish home from the beach.
I will bring my own bag when I go shopping.
Good. Small actions can make a big difference.
